summary: This milestone tracks going proposals for the fourth version of the Table Spec The PR replaces GCSFileIO.deleteFiles with StorageBatch to provide per-object outcome reporting. It proposes adding a catalogName method to the action and explores alternatives like querying FileIO for configuration, with tests covering various catalog scenarios. The pull request proposes enabling aggregate pushdown for queries that GROUP BY identity partition columns in Spark. Currently Iceberg only pushes down aggregates for non‑GROUP BY queries, so this change would allow faster execution by using file metadata for grouped results.
